ip.title: Public IP Address
ip.description: Your public IP is used as a session identifier. Go to https://whatismyipaddress.com/ to get.

macAddresses.title: HVAC MAC Addresses (Optional)
macAddresses.description: Optional: List of specific MAC Addresses to connect to. Leave empty to auto-discover ALL HVACs on your account.

twocaptcha_api_key.title: 2Captcha API Key
twocaptcha_api_key.description: Required for the initial login. Cost is about $0.003 per solve. Since v2.2.0 the plugin reuses a refresh token, so it normally solves only once per install - typically a few cents total, not per reconnect.
